name: code-3d-extrude
title: Code 3D Extrude
description: A syntax-highlighted code card on a thick lit slab: it swings in from an angle, settles face-on with a cool key light and a green rim light on its edges, and then drifts a little at rest. WebGL.
useWhen: A code snippet shown on a physical-looking slab that turns to face the viewer, for developer tools and tutorial intros.
A hero shot of a short feature snippet with some depth.
avoidWhen: Long snippets: the slab is fitted to the frame, so long code gets small.
A flat, UI-style presentation of code.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Code
variables.description: The snippet shown. Use line breaks; JavaScript-like syntax is highlighted with a GitHub-dark palette.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Code text needs 0.75.
